tagline: Underground nights, one record at a time
brief: A personal brand for a DJ and rave night, Rave with Jacob. It has to feel loud, dark and hand-made, read instantly on a flyer or a 16 px tab, and stand apart from generic EDM neon.
criteria: Success: owns the J, nods to vinyl without drawing a turntable, works in one colour, survives 16 px.

concepts.name: Vinyl J
concepts.idea: The J's hook is half a spinning record: one groove, one spindle.
rationale: A letter mark that belongs to Jacob, not to a genre
Vinyl is implied by a single groove, not drawn literally
Acid green on night black reads like a club light, yet works in pure black
Small-size cut drops the groove so the favicon stays crisp

recommendation: Vinyl J with the stacked RAVE WITH / JACOB name.
